arsenic can be absorbed and accumulated by tea plant, and the accumulation of arsenic in the tea plant can be used as a marker of the arsenic content in tea.
arsenic has negative effect on the growth of tea plant, and the distribution of arsenic is not even in different organs.
arsenic can cause the toxicity of tea plant, and its toxicity is dose-dependent.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the growth and anti-arsenic ability of different cultivars of tea plant,as well as absorption and accumulation of arsenic in different organs of tea plant under different concentrations of arsenic intimidation, which provides some scientific basis for further research of the anti-arsenic mechanism of tea plant.

the growth and arsenic content in different tea plant cultivars under different concentrations of arsenic intimidation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

tea plant has a certain ability of anti-arsenics,and the arsenic content in tea plant is mainly concentrated in the rootstalk and fresh tip,which should be the main object of the arsenic pollution in tea plant.

the arsenic contents in the organs of tea plant are in the order of fresh stalk>fresh tip>rootstalk>leaf,which indicates that arsenic content in fresh shoot of tea plant may be the best index to evaluate the quality of tea.
the tea shoot is sensitive to arsenic, and the arsenic contents in various organs of tea plant are in a regular distribution, and the arsenical content in the fresh shoot of tea plant is the highest.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
arsenic has negative effect on the tea plant growth,while the effect is not the same in different cultivars,which is related with their different anti-arsenic ability.
the arsenic contents in tea plant is closely associated with the concentration in nourish solution,and the distribution and accumulative characteristics are also related with the growth of tea shoot.

the growth of tea plant is inhibited seriously under the situation of arsenic intimidation,and arsenic contents in the organs of tea plant are increased remarkably,which will cause serious harm to the tea quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the arsenic content in tea plant is positively correlated with the concentration of arsenic, and the arsenic content of the one bud with the two leaves of the fresh tip is the highest, which is a potential health risk.

the arsenic content in tea leaves is positively correlated with the arsenic concentration of tea water and the arsenic content of tea leaves is higher than that of the roots,so that the arsenic concentration in the leaves can be used as an important index to evaluate the arsenic contamination of tea.
the tea shoot of Fuding white tea has stronger anti-arsenic ability than that of the two cultivars of Fuding black tea,and the accumulation of arsenic in fresh tip is higher.
